An Act to provide for the salaries of the Ministers of the State of Rajasthan.
Whereas it is expedient to provide for the salaries of the ministers of the State of Rajasthan
and for other matters connected therewith;
Be it enacted by the Rajasthan State Legislature in the Seventh Year of the Republic
of India as follows:-
